note: Lexical hit-rate baseline for minicc/agent/retrieval.py. Each case is a known-answer localization query: the developer ask plus the repo-relative file(s) that answer it. recall@k = |targets ∩ top-k| / |targets|, averaged over cases; MRR uses the rank of the first target. Per the M4-T7 roadmap this only establishes a baseline — CI records the numbers but does not gate on them.
